## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote in SkillOffice format as a numbered process; body about 75 lines.
- Narrowed to a product angle (features, positioning gaps, build or differentiate decisions); sales battle cards and marketing messaging are handed off to the Sales and Marketing departments.
- Removed connector steps (knowledge base, chat) and the slash-command usage block. Web research uses the platform's own search only when available and the user agrees; every claim needs a source and date or is marked unverified.
- Moved landscape mapping, rating scales, the matrix template, positioning frameworks, win/loss method and trend analysis into `references/competitive-methods.md`, condensed. Removed named third-party review sites and analyst firms as required sources.
- Competitor list and target audience come from the SkillOffice context profile; prices stay in their original currency.
- Added a rule against obtaining confidential competitor material, a quality checklist, a safety note and a handoff section.
